label: Performance gauges
desc: Four layered dashboard instruments (tachometer, speedometer, boost gauge, EV power meter) whose needles ease to the values you pass.
use: Vehicle or device status panels, diagnostics dashboards, telemetry heroes (fills its parent; pass `values`).

label: Uplink loader
desc: A cinematic secure-connection loader with a stepped segmented bar, telemetry ticks, scanline and grain; determinate progress with live status text.
use: Sign-in handshakes, app boot or sync screens (pass progress 0-100, or leave it to autoplay as a demo).

label: Fish card stack
desc: A tactile stack of three illustrated fish cards with CSS 3D depth and pointer tilt; drag, tap, buttons or keys bring the next card forward.
use: Portfolio or gallery teasers, feature highlights, onboarding card stacks (fills its parent).

label: Page curl sketchbook
desc: A paper sketchbook of invented SVG drawings with a drag-driven page curl, a magnifier lens, arrow-key page turns and prev/next buttons.
use: Portfolio and lookbook showcases, product catalogues, story pages (fills its parent).
